caseName: Tucker v. City of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: Linda Tucker, James Tucker, Jeffrey Tucker, and George Konik v. City of Los Angeles, California

opinions.text: Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until March 28, 2011, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
